examples.input: This OPC article makes me think I should build a company with AI employees. Which parts should I absorb into my system?
expected_behavior: Separates article narrative from reusable rules.
Preserves human bottleneck, management layer, value loop, service boundary, and hype calibration rules.
Rejects extreme funding stories as weak decision evidence.
Suggests a narrow rule or skill module instead of bloating core operating principles.

examples.input: I want to build an AI employee platform and let one management Agent direct five execution Agents for coding, content, sales, support, and research.
expected_behavior: Checks whether the human bottleneck is direction, verification, or context integration.
Runs adversarial partner questions about demand and support burden.
Proposes a minimal probe before building the full platform.
